(async () => {
  const link = document.createElement('link');
  link.rel = 'stylesheet';
  const outcomes = [];
  const change = href => new Promise(resolve => {
    const finish = event => {
      outcomes.push([event.type, event.target === link, event.isTrusted, event.bubbles]);
      link.removeEventListener('load', finish);
      link.removeEventListener('error', finish);
      resolve(event.type);
    };
    link.addEventListener('load', finish);
    link.addEventListener('error', finish);
    link.href = href;
    if (!link.isConnected) document.head.append(link);
  });
  const denied = await change('https://foreign.test/blocked.css');
  const failedSheet = link.sheet === null;
  const recovered = await change('/document-stylesheets-assets/0.css');
  const loadedSheet = link.sheet !== null;
  const deniedAgain = await change('https://foreign.test/blocked-again.css');
  const result = {
    denied: denied === 'error',
    failedSheet,
    recovered: recovered === 'load' && loadedSheet,
    deniedAgain: deniedAgain === 'error' && link.sheet === null,
    events: outcomes.length === 3 && outcomes.every(event => event[1] && event[2] && !event[3]),
    lifecycle: document.readyState === 'complete'
  };
  link.remove();
  return result;
})()
